Buoc 1: doi hex sang nhi phan, chua ma hoa DES.

Test 1:
Ban ro = 0123456789ABCDEF
Khoa = 133457799BBCDFF1
Ban ro (64 bit) = 0000000100100011010001010110011110001001101010111100110111101111
Khoa   (64 bit) = 0001001100110100010101110111100110011011101111001101111111110001
Ket qua dung.

Test 2:
Ban ro = 01234567
Thong bao: Ban ro khong hop le.
Ket qua dung.

Buoc 2: hoan vi IP va tach L0, R0.

Ban ro = 0123456789ABCDEF
Khoa = 133457799BBCDFF1
Sau IP = 1100110000000000110011001111111111110000101010101111000010101010
L0 = 11001100000000001100110011111111
R0 = 11110000101010101111000010101010
Ket qua dung. Chua thuc hien 16 vong DES.
